name: How long does it take to install an outdoor kitchen with new cabinetry?
description: Installation of outdoor kitchen cabinetry typically takes 1-6 weeks, depending on complexity and additional features like utility connections.

mainEntity.name: How long does it take to install an outdoor kitchen with new cabinetry?

acceptedAnswer.text: The installation timeframe for an outdoor kitchen with new cabinetry varies depending on the project's complexity, size, and chosen materials. A basic installation might take 1-2 weeks, while more elaborate designs with custom features or extensive utility connections could extend to 3-6 weeks. This timeline typically follows the design and planning phases. As a construction company serving areas like Alameda and Berkeley, Hometelligent Inc. often coordinates cabinetry installation with other outdoor living elements, such as utility hook-ups for gas or plumbing, which can influence the overall schedule.
